objective_contribution: Test whether deterministic process state, rather than source access alone, helps GLM-5.3-flash resume useful reasoning after local recycling at 8K and improve native ContextBench evidence selection within the same cumulative model-token cap.

question_and_hypotheses.question: After actual local recycling, does a compact deterministic projection of task objective, evidence, repository changes, and test/search outcomes improve native evidence selection within the same cumulative model-token cap?

measurement_mapping.native: Paired ContextBench span and file metrics measure selected source overlap; they do not establish repair correctness or semantic retention by themselves.
measurement_mapping.retention: Verified post-recycle use of projected facts or recovered evidence establishes mechanism exposure; useful retention additionally requires improved native outcomes or completed correctness evidence.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Every projected fact must bind to a task input, successful request receipt, tool event, or repository result; projection creates no delivery credit or effect.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count every model input and output token, including projection presentation, recovery, failed submissions, and corrections. Local deterministic projection consumes no optimization cost until model-visible.
measurement_mapping.transfer: One exposed GLM 8K development round cannot establish other-window, other-model, non-code, or full-cohort transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter first; 8K development before 10K/12K and reserved confirmation.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Round one through round five and the eight round-four development identities are exposed. Reserved confirmation stays untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No within-round tuning, task replacement, source refresh, threshold changes, or lucky reruns. Pause unstarted cells only for shared provider or instrument failure and retain every attempt.

retained_counterevidence: Round four index arms made 31 exact recovery calls and recovered 46,555 bytes, including seven repeated reads, so lack of mechanism exposure is false.
Round-four scoreable pairs gained only 0.000819 macro span F1 and lost 0.01333 file F1; aggregate index-arm model tokens were 77,656 higher.
Round five fixed terminal validity on a three-task exposed cohort, but valid serialization does not prove useful state, semantic retention, or repair correctness.
A deterministic process projection can preserve observed facts yet still distract GLM, omit its latent plan, or fail to improve semantic evidence choice.
successor_rule: Implement and freeze H11 only after the state fact allowlist, adversarial integrity checks, exact matrix, and freeze-phase continuity review pass. If the fixed development outcome target passes, prepare an untouched confirmation candidate under the acceptance contract. If it fails, record typed counterevidence and select H12, H0, or a new competing hypothesis from the observed failure. Never rerun H11 unchanged, lower thresholds, infer full clearance, or transition automatically to another benchmark.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: Preserved as useful reasoning, continuity, recovery, correctness and completion under total model-token cost.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: H11 directly targets GLM-5.3-flash recovery after actual recycling at 8K; larger windows remain later.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The fixed ContextBench contract remains the milestone and remains uncleared.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: Round-four H1 counterevidence and round-five H9 support lead through an explicit gap, question, H11/H12/H0 selection, future experiment, observation and decision chain.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Recovery exposure, quality failure, extra tokens, and the semantic ceiling are retained and constrain H11.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Native selection, mechanism exposure, integrity, correctness limits and all model input/output tokens are separated.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: Exposed 8K development only; SWE-bench excluded; full identities, windows, tiers and reserved repetitions unchanged.
criterion_verdicts.testability: H11 has a deterministic mechanism, matched control, fixed development threshold, false-fact falsifier and stopping rules.
